items.html: And on Rosh Chodesh, ZON use one crown — meaning they are both included in the Netzah of AA, and they receive their illumination in one equivalence, and the male has no advantage over the female. And on the Shabbatot, ZON ascend up to the Keter of AVI, and he is included in Aba, and she is included in Ima; and the two are not equal in one equivalence, and therefore she receives her illumination through him.
